bash_commands: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v __pycache__ | head -100 && cat CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null

for f in pixforge/features/generate.py pixforge/features/common.py pixforge/features/video.py pixforge/billing.py pixforge/pricing.py pixforge/jobs.py pixforge/images.py pixforge/migrations/*.sql pixforge/db.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done
for f in lumen_sdk/*.py docs/lumen_api.md tests/fakes.py tests/conftest.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done
cat pixforge/jobs.py pixforge/images.py pixforge/migrations/001_init.sql pixforge/migrations/002_quota.sql pixforge/db.py
cat pixforge/quota.py pixforge/sweeper.py pixforge/features/video.py pixforge/i18n.py pixforge/locales/en.json pixforge/locales/ru.json pixforge/users.py pixforge/features/__init__.py

cat tests/test_i18n.py tests/test_billing.py tests/test_sweeper.py tests/test_video.py pyproject.toml && grep -rn "quota\|source_image\|create_job(" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./tests/test_generate"
